clauses.title: Exact autofix declares and checks cross-operation input shapes
requires: `envelope`, `data`, and `receipt` are distinct input shapes
the map names the shape each field expects, not only the field
no shape is accepted as a tolerant alternative for another
a supplied shape that is not the declared one stops with `input_shape_mismatch`
never as a later identity, capture, or evidence failure
it is not a validator of producer output
rejected because it fails that one predicate, never because of what it was recognized to be
calibrated to what fails downstream
the closed CL-D36 schema remains the sole validator of gate results
constructed by hand to satisfy a declared predicate passes
The five declared fields are the complete CL-D44 set

clauses.title: The invocation map publishes each field's declared shape
requires: `captured` (envelope of `operator_capture`, or its complete payload, CL-D70)
`expected` (data of `workspace_create`)
`receipt` (receipt inside `workspace_create` data)
`snapshot` (data of `snapshot`)
`result` (structured gate output)

clauses.title: README documents the declared input shapes
requires: declares one input shape for each cross-operation field
rejects any other shape with `input_shape_mismatch` before the operation runs
instead of letting it surface later as an unrelated identity or capture failure

clauses.title: Black-box composition tests pin the declarations, the swaps, and the positives
requires: each declared field carries one predicate and rejection needs no classification
the declared shapes are published beside the fields
the envelope-for-data swap is rejected by name at the boundary
every other declared field rejects the shapes it does not take
the documented composition passes exactly as written
structured gate output composes successfully and rejects envelope/data/receipt swaps
